trinket_maker.note: the trinket maker. Lyss's own NPC, holding a puoro.

player.note: the original player figure. Kept as the default so the world looks the same as it did.

player_b.note: red top, green cargos. The widest silhouette of the four.

player_c.note: hat and long coat. Reads instantly at distance, which none of the others do.

player_d.note: dark jacket and boots. The compact, low-contrast one.

wanderer_a.note: walking, holding a cup. Mid-stride, so he reads as passing through.

wanderer_b.note: orange, one hand up. From the Maori punks sheet.

karu.note: A cutout that arrived in the working tree labelled Karu, from a paper drawing photographed under reference/art-source/. Not confirmed hers, not approved, and NOT rendered: it has a face, and Karu has no body or face until she says. Kept registered so the asset test keeps its PNG honest; nothing reads this entry at runtime.
